title: Does anyone remember projected random colored lights playing before a movie?

commenti.body: Yes. You weren't on drugs, that happened. It was a disk of colored oils, differing viscosity so they didn't mix, with a light projected through. And if you really want to blow your mind, listen to this. The tune that often played before coming attractions: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CxHcfJ2xslM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CxHcfJ2xslM)

Hmmm...  the tune doesn't ring a bell, but you're describing the thing I saw.  

Mainly I'm interested what this thing was called...  and maybe even seeing a video of the thing again.
"Oil wheel projector" is one of the most common terms but there's no clear standard. They were common with rock bands in the '60s or anyone trying to create a psychedelic vibe.
omg, I've been looking for this tune forever! my local indie cinema plays the visuals that OP is talking about to this tune. it's such a vibe.
That's it.  Thanks.  Another great example of having to know the word for a thing to find it though google.

Professional lighting nerd here. The general term is usually "liquid light show". Or "oil projection" (though if you google that, you're going to mostly just get a lot of stuff about the oil industry). Usually made with some combination of overhead projectors and crude spinning color wheels.

If you want to do a deep dive, it was pioneered by a guy named Joshua White, who created the Joshua Light Show in the 1960s.
https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Joshua_Light_Show

OP might peruse the videos shared on this YT channel, lots of theatrical intros: https://www.youtube.com/@FTDepot/videos

Is it maybe something like this? I have no idea of its date: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VY5p597dbf0
Generations of British cinema goers feel mildly excited when they hear this one https://youtu.be/Iom-g1cbGzI?si=FYkK1YAsshq1s4O-

The kit often used to produce this effect was the Optikinetic Solar 250 - a projection device with interchangeable gobos and effects wheels. I remember a cinema that had 2 of these, one either side of the screen.
Plex has an option to add things like this before movies start, I'll be grabbing these and shuffling them! Thank you

This certainly happened every week in the UK if you were a kid and attended the Saturday Morning Cinema Club. Part of the programme was the week’s top ten played to an oil projection, heady stuff. I can’t remember if I saw it played at a regular showing, but my regular cinema trips were few and far between.

“Oil wheel projector” is your best route to exploring the tech, though I can’t guarantee these were what we saw at the time (but they’re surely the best bet). There are modern equivalents:

- https://mathmos.com/lava-lamps/spares-extras/projector-effects/
- https://bubblevision.uk/Oil-Wheels-Cassettes/Buy-Oil-Wheels/BV4671_bubble_vision_oil_wheel/
- https://www.amazon.co.uk/Mathmos-Space-Projector-Oil-Wheel/dp/B000K22WEU
